final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE observstation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.observstation, sc.telescope_count, sc.telescope_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share FROM station_counts sc JOIN totals t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares s JOIN avg_share a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
